why: Finally a clean head-on view: teal top and bottom rails with two yellow posts forming the gate, opening sitting slightly right of frame-center. The proposed move is translate-only (yaw-1.1, effectively none) with dy-0.90 shifting right toward the opening's center and dx+0.78 closing distance - exactly the kind of single clean run-through the brief asks for on a crossing, and this is the last decision, so approving to take the shot at the left gate now rather than nudge further.
